evidence.report: Compared all 24 matched revision 002 images with the supplied references. This candidate replaces the stiff coat fins with fuller, curved panels and a rounded asymmetric ground spread; adjusts the raised and late near-hand poses, open-hand silhouettes, and late-orbit framing; shifts the muzzle and opening camera; and widens the second cloth close-up to expose more roof. It retains the complete absolute-time timeline and editable geometric actors. Remaining approximations include facial detail, realistic cloth dynamics, optical bullet wakes, atmosphere, and motion between the 24 supplied samples. These changes have not yet been rendered.
